# CI Gating Requirements Quality Checklist: Skip CI for Spec-Only Changes

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the spec-only CI-skip requirements before implementation (PR reviewer, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is "build, test, or deployment work" defined precisely enough to classify every existing job as in or out of scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "lightweight workflow run" bounded (permitted jobs, duration, cost, no secrets/environments)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for which branches/events count as "any branch" (including tags and forks)? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements stated for classifying pull-request events, given the plan only classifies `push` and fails open otherwise? [Gap, Conflict, Spec §US1, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the future-workflow obligation (FR-004) expressed as a verifiable requirement rather than only a documented pattern? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the constitution amendment that exempts spec-only changes from validation? [Gap, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "top-level `specs/` directory" unambiguous for case sensitivity and look-alikes (`specs-old/`, `SPECS.md`, `src/specs/`)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "final diff" defined (base/head refs, merge-base vs. before..after) for pushes, merges, and PRs? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the treatment of renames between `specs/` and elsewhere stated in the spec, not only in research? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "same triggering conditions as before" defined so unchanged behavior can be compared objectively? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the "no workflows run" input and acceptance wording align with the clarified "lightweight runs permitted" outcome? [Consistency, Spec §Input, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Are US1 scenario 3 (merge) and the assumption that merges don't trigger PR workflows consistent? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "fail open" behavior consistent with FR-001/SC-001's 100% claim, and listed as an exception? [Conflict, Spec §SC-001, Research §3]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the platform-limit exceptions (1,000 commits, 300 files) consistent with research stating the 300-file limit does not apply? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §6]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-003 ("under 5 minutes") be objectively measured, and is the starting point defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are acceptance criteria defined for the status-check names that must remain unchanged? [Gap, Research §5]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-004 measurable for both the spec-only (merge allowed) and failed-validation (merge blocked) cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a new-branch push, force-push, or missing base commit? [Coverage, Edge Case, Research §3]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for an empty diff (e.g., revert-to-same-tree)? [Edge Case, Data Model §Classification]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for classifier failure/timeouts and its effect on required checks? [Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for changes to `.github/` workflow files that alter the gating itself? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery requirements specified if a skipped run later needs to be executed (manual re-run/dispatch)? [Recovery, Gap]

## Non-Functional & Security

- [ ] CHK023 Are least-privilege requirements for the classifier (permissions, secrets, environments) stated as requirements? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution IV]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the classifier's performance target quantified ("well under 1 minute")? [Clarity, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the risk of untrusted PR input reaching the classifier addressed in requirements? [Gap, Security]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that skipped jobs satisfy required checks validated against GitHub's documented behavior? [Assumption, Research §1]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements for maintainer-approved repository-settings changes defined (who, when, rollback)? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on `fetch-depth: 0` and its checkout-cost impact documented as a requirement or constraint? [Assumption, Research §6]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
